headline: High Season for Deposits: What Will Happen to Deposit Rates at the Start of September
summary: Ukrainian financial institutions will begin targeted adjustments to deposit conditions between 31 August and 6 September. The changes follow the regulator's updated decisions.
why: Deposit rates set by Ukrainian banks determine returns on household savings and banks' funding costs, and they respond to central bank policy.
